sanskrit: bho saṃhitā mahābhāga gorakṣasya mahātmanaḥbrūhi bho loka nāthaṃ tejā nihitaṃ mahātmanamśṛṇu priye mahadgopyaṃ gurunātha namostutemārgāraṇye mahāsthāne siṃhavyāghrā hi seviteprādurbhāvo viṣṇumāyā brahmāgre prāptasaṃsthitādṛṣṭvā viraṃcināgne vai nartasīlā pulocanāamoghavīryasaṃprāpya garmiṇī sā pulocanājātakarmādikaṃ sarvaṃ viśraveṇa yathā kṛtaḥgodhano nāma nṛpate tasya kanyā sulocanānāmaṃ cakāra vidhivad gorakṣakṛta viśravāḥbrahmaputro mahāyātrā sādhyobhutkā maheśvariprāpte putravatī nārī mahāharṣavatī śubhābhārgavaṃ gurusaṃprāpya vipāraṃbhakṛtākilatasmin kāle gurorbhāryāṃ gorakṣeṇa ca sevanamtataḥ śramābhārgavasya prāptā śrīviśravā munidṛṣṭvācenbhrātarā nāryā karṇaṃ chedati gotsavekṣaṇe bhasma mahaṃsaknu sāpaṃ te brahmakaṇṭakakāraṇaṃ yacchṛṇu prāṇa gorakṣo karṇachedakaḥgorakṣopi ca tatsthāne guruṇā karṇachedakāḥguruṇādi yatāṃ bheṣaṃ karṇabhaṅgaṃ śikhāchinatvṛttānta kṛtayā māsa parameṣṭhi gatā puresikṣayāmāsaśāstrāṇi gorakṣadharma paraṃ śivakarṇabhaṃgaṃ svayaṃ kṛtya gaṃdharva asikaṃ kaṇaiḥparaṃbrahma svayaṃ vidyāmāpāstotuṃ pracakramegorakṣasya pathotpatti bhārate paṭhyate sadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00291 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nityaṃ paṭhati yo dhīmān ciṃtāmaṇi bhavet priyabhavān bhaktyā prasādena śrāvayāmi niśāmayaprasādaṃ maṅgalā mātrāmekacittaṃ varānanetṛtīyaṃ gururūpaṃ ca caturthaṃ nādahastakamsaptamaṃ bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ rudrarūpaṃ tathāṣṭamamsundarī sevakaṃ caiva ekādaśa varānanepaṭhati prāṇadhārī ca sarvasiddhirbhavetkilagorakṣaṃte prasannostu vāñchāsiddhirbhavaṃti hiśrīgorakṣadvādaśanāmastotraṃ gorakṣaguṭikāyāṃ dvitīyapaṭalaḥkathaṃ gorakṣanāthasya kavacaṃ maṃtravigrahamdhanyatvaṃ puṇyaśīletvaṃ śrānayāmi varānaneśṛṇu priye śailakanye vadāmi kila sāṃpratambhālaṃ lalāṭe nāthena pātutvāṃ rakṣaśaṃkaraprāṇaṃ rakṣet ghoṭakena gorakṣeṇa sadāvatukarṇaṃ rakṣen mahākāla śrotraṃ gorakṣamūrtinābālarakṣedraktamūrti śikhāgorakṣamūrtinādagnaṃ? rakṣeva vyāghrapāda gorakṣamūrti maheśvaraḥgrīvāṃ rakṣet kaṃkarūpaṃ sarvaṃ gorakṣamūrtinābāhupātu virūpākṣa brahmaputraṃ ca gorakṣaḥsarvāṃguliṃ bahirājā tejorūpaṃ ca gorakṣaḥnābhau rakṣet mahābhīma kuṃḍīrūpaṃ ca gorakṣaḥkaṭiṃ pātu mahādeva yogamūrtiṃ ca gorakṣaḥalakaṃ rakṣate saiva mattonmattaṃ ca gorakṣaḥūrūṃ rakṣed gadā rūpamahaṃ gorakṣarūpitādhīrakṣentālamūrtiṃ padmatālaṃ ca gorakṣaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00291 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pādāṅgulī śrīdharaṃ ca viśvarūpaṃ ca gorakṣaḥmajjāraktamayaṃ pātu tvakākṣaraṃ sālvamūrtināatirakṣenmahākāla bhairavatva ca gorakṣaḥbhāryāṃ rakṣedviṣṇurūpa vande gorakṣasāmbhavaḥmātṛpitṛ sadārakṣeddhīmatā gorakṣa svayamrājadvāre guru sākṣādrakṣedvā ca svarūpitāiti kavaca vyākhyātaṃ gorakṣasya varānanebrahmakṣatriya viṭvaṃśā trayojātāmupāsitābhurjapatre likhed yaṃtraṃ bāhau vā dhārayiṣyatiasikaṃkaṇanodadhāntaḥ ṛkṣavyāghrādito bhayātsaṃsāre lokavāsaṃ yadyonarāmarakinnarāḥsarvān bhaya vināśeṣu vajradeha samo bhavetgorakṣasya prasādena vāṃchāsiddhi bhavet kilapunargorakṣanāthasya kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasināma śrīgorakṣaguṭikāyāṃ tṛtīyapaṭalaḥkathaṃ maṃtra kathaṃ yaṃtra kiṃ kiṃ bhāva vadāmi tegorakṣasyapimānāya mama tulya kathaṃ bhavetgorakṣasya hṛdayaṃ yaṃtrān nānāvidhānakamtava bhaktyā prasādena śṛṇu te mama vākyatanāmamādikaṃ vālagorakṣoyaṃ mahātmanaḥduḥkhī bhūtvā imāṃ bāla brāhmaṇānāṃ ca godhanamkālamekaṃ daivayogād gogaṇai sahitā vanegarale pīḍitā teṣāṃ mṛtyukālavasaṃ gataḥcakrurodana sarve gau hāhākārāgavegaṇāme dṛṣṭvā tena ākāśāt karuṇāṃbhud varānane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00291 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mṛtadehe ahaṃ gatvā avisaṃkitaniścayaḥnāmaiṣāṃ viśrave tasya kāryaṃ ca gaugaṇena cayogendrasya gṛhe gatvā gavāṃ saṃtoṣakāraṇamna jñāti iha saṃyoga nānā māyāṃ kṛtā mahamyatheṣṭaṃ gacchabhagava unmādaṃ bhāvabālakaḥiti śrutvā mayā gaurī niścayā māsate gṛhātmama tulya bhaved gaurī kāraṇaṃ yanmaheśvarīkavacaṃ ca yathā kurvan yattaṃddhṛdayakaṃ śṛṇugurumahātrailokya rakṣāṃ kurusarvaduṣṭādi vācābhyāṃ staṃbhaṃ nāśaya 2saptaviṃśan mahāmaṃtraṃ maṃtravarṇānanekasaśrīyaṃtravasinī siddhā gurumūrti namāmyahamniśāyāṃ paścime yāme japitvā mṛga āsanesādhanaṃ gurudevāya trailokya rakṣaṇāya cabrahmacarya vidhānena gorakṣasādhanaṃ kṛtāsaptatriṃsallakṣajapaṃ niśiṃkāleṣu uttamayajñasālā prakurvanti juhuyāt tilarāyikājapasya sādhakān sarve daśāṃśaṃ juhuyāt kilataddaśāṃśairbrahmakanyā pūjayed dvija bhojanamlikhet paṃcopacāreṇa pūjayed gurudevatāmpunarvṛttacatuṣkoṇa māyā bījena veṣṭayetiti gorakṣayaṃtrāṇi sādhakena sadārcayetsiddhiṃ gorakṣa maṃtreṇa vāṃcchasiddhirbhavet kilaekaṃ bhavati gorakṣa smaret sarvaughanāśanamvilīnaṃ sarvapāpānāṃ jaḍamūlo bhaviṣyati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00291 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nānā bhaya vināśānāṃ paracakra vighāṭakānuccāṭanaṃ krameṇaiva samādhāna bhaviṣyatimārjanaṃ sarvakāryāṇi maṃtrasiddhi bhavet priyemaṇḍapaṃ kārayāmāsa sarvakāryeṣu tatparaḥsiddhiṃ prāpyaṃ tu paścāt tvāṃ yaṃtreṣu pūjanaṃ sadāpaṃcopacāraiḥ tāṃ pūjāṃ sarvakāryeṣu sādhakāḥtaṃtre mate śailaputri agnisthāpana pūrvakamvistarācchṛṇu bho gaurī sarvameva vadāmiteaṣṭasiddhirbhavet sarve sādhakaiḥ kila prāpnuyāttrirātre maraṇaṃ teṣāṃ śatruvargā varānanemohane haṃsamaudgalyāṃ kaliṃgai śṛṃgasarvatāuccāṭane ca unmāde mahiṣaṃ naraghātitepāyasairmadhurālāpaiḥ pūgītāṃbūlasaṃyutaiḥyati krīḍaṃ devasya brahmaputra namostutejapecchrī gurudevasya mālāmaṃtra varānanemahāśreṣṭhaṃ surendrādi madhye bhārata khaṇḍatagurukule gorakṣanāthaṃ bhajeudāsīṃ jaya jaya gurute vaṃditādesamūrtiḥindriṃsu phala sa guruṇāvaṃditāṃ nityarājamkṛtāṃ madyapānāṃ mahonmattarūpāṃ jagadrāvayattāṃ mahārudrarūpāmkīlakaṃ tatpravakṣyāmi ekacittaṃ kuru priyeśrīgorakṣanātha hṛdayaṃ nāma caturthapaṭalaḥpūjāvidhānaṃ bho gaurī etesāmagnikaṃ śṛṇuśrīkhaṇḍaṃ malayaṃ bhūtaṃ raktacandanasiṃdurāḥnānasugaṃdhapuṣpāṇi guggulaṃ silhakādikāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00291 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: phalaṃ ca nānā pakvānnaiva liṃnānāvidhāni cadivyavastrasamānīya gairikādi kṛtā yathāmaṃtraṃ śṛṇu maheśāni pravakṣyāmi mayākilaāgacha brahmaputratvaṃ rudra aṃśasamanvitaḥpaścānmūlena daśadhā śodhayed gurumaṃtrataḥstavarāja maheśāni gorakṣasya śṛṇu priyepaṃcamastaraṅgaḥmahāpuṇyavato gaurī śrīguropādaciṃtakāphalaṃ subhade śrīguroḥ pāda vandeparamihalabhate śrīguroḥ pāda vandejahi mama ariṇāṃ śrīguroḥ pāda vandesukhade nartaśīlādi vaṃdemama tulyaṃ bhavejjantu satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥśṛṇu priye pravakṣyāmi mahāmokṣaniśāmayaṣaṣṭhastaraṃgaḥmaṃtranātha namastubhyaṃ ekanetre namāmyahamgaurikādi vāsaṃ dharāgorakṣa tvaṃ namo namaḥviśravā bhrātarastubhyaṃ gorakṣāya namo namaḥdhanyatvaṃ gurugorakṣabrahmaputra namostuteyogīkula sadāvāsa brahmeṃdrāya namo namaḥjalaṃdharāya yogāya gorakṣāya namo namaḥnātha pādaṃ namastestu gorakṣāya namo namaḥviśveśvarāya viśvāya gorakṣāya namo namaḥnareṇa paṭhate nityaṃ aṣṭasiddhi samo bhavetrakṣāṣṭakastotraṃ saptamastaraṃgaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00291 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sāndraṃ mānapure deva paṃcāṅgasya phalaṃ pathāstotraṃ mayākṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ paṃcāṃgaṃ pūraṇāya caarthadharmakāmamokṣe ca manovāṃchāphalapradamdyūtakrīḍādi pāpānāṃ jaḍamūlo bhaviṣyatibhaginī gamanaṃ caiva na sthirā agni tejavatnityaṃ paṭhati yo dhīmān tasyāṅge pāpa na sthirāḥkanyārthī labhate kanyāṃ patnyarthī patnimāpnuyātputrārthī labhate putraṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ varānaneśrīguronāthagorakṣaṃ praṇamāmi sadā priyeśrīgurugorakṣanāthaprasannadvārā aṣṭottaraśatanāmastotra pāṭhe viniyogaḥśālagrāmaśāntamūrti śaileśvara vṛṣeśvaraḥmāneśvarādi mūrtiṃ ca dhanurdhara vidhīsutaḥyajñeśvaro yajñakāṃtaḥ pakṣarāja umādharaḥpulocanāpuṇyamūrti puruṣottama pauṇḍrakaḥkaśyapa bhrātaro nāda yogī gaṇya guṇākaraḥsiddhāmaṇi gītapati saṅkarṣaṇanareśvaraḥparameṣṭhi jagaddhāma śrīmaṃta śrīśrīyaṃ karaḥsūryarūpa dhyānamūrti karṇasphaṭika maṇḍitasphaṭikakuṇḍalakaṇṭhakāla rūpo bhayānakaḥraktāmbaro raktamūrti raktanetra kuleśvaraḥbhuktinātha muktinātha naranātha narāntakaḥlalajihvā chatra hasto sundarī sevakopamaḥstotraṃ paṭhati yo dhīmān gorakṣāṣṭottaraṃ śatamiha loke sukhaṃ bhuktā cānte mukti puraṃ labhetaṣṭottaraśatanāmastotramaṣṭamastaraṅgaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00291 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: praṇamāmi sadā vande yogī yogeśvaraḥ prabhuprathamotpatti stotraṃ ca dvādaśākhyā dvitīyakampūjāvyākhyādikaṃ sarvaṃ paṃcamaṃ kīlakaṃ tathāaṣṭaka saptame stotraṃ prasādāt tava śaṃkaraśrūyatāṃ aṣṭamaṃ sarve maṃtrataṃtrāṇi jāni hipunargorakṣanāthasya śrotumicchāmi saṃhitāvada sarvaṃ kṛpāsiṃdho śrotumicchāmi bho prabhogorakṣanāthamaṃtrādī sarvaṃ vai kathayāmitepaścāt sahasra nāmāni pravakṣāmi tavādhunāpurākalpe maṇīdvīpe jaganmātā virājatepuṣpakaṃ tatsamāhṛtya vimānaṃ paramādbhutamkāle divaṃ latāmūrti nirjalasthāna prāpnutāviṣṇuṃ ca koṭyaṃ satyaṃ yadvai kuṇṭhaṃ parvataṃ mayāgatvāhaṃ mahadāścaryaṃ brahmāviṣṇu mayā yathānānāvṛkṣaiḥ samāyuktā nānā pabhi virājitāgītavādyai mahāghoṣaiḥ bahunṛtyaivarāṅganaiḥasmākamatrisaṃbhārya komalaiḥ tapasā sthitaiḥmṛgādi sahakrīḍābhi gambhīrai nṛttaśīlabhisthāne sthāne munigaṇaitapasaṃ karṣaṇai pumānmanuṣyai rākṣasaimatvān sahakrīḍā manoharāngatvāmatsyādikān yāme sudhāsiṃdhu pravāhakānsukhaṃ ca paramaṃ kālāddaṃpati jñāna cakṣuṣānparṇaiḥ vyāptā mahāramyaiḥ śatayojanavistṛtaiḥpaṃktiṃ cakārayaṃtrādi samudraisye bhitā sadāmayūrapicchanilayaṃ sadya caṃdrodayai subhaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00291 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatkāleṣu niyamaṃ vimānaṃ tararaṃhasāsarvatejo samūhena sundarī cārubhūṣitānsundaraṃ cāru śobhāḍhyaṃ pramamaṃkaṃ prakāśitākanyāmekaṃ kumāraikaṃ teja asmāt prakāśitāḥtadgatvā ca mahāramye sundaraṃ cātiśobhitambrahmāviṣṇustathā mahyaṃ īśvarīpādaśaṃkaraḥviśvamātā viśālākṣī bhuvaneśī maheśvarīvimānaṃ tarasā kāle bhūmyai uttarasaṃsthitāḥmahadāścarya prāpnoti viruddhaviśvaraṃhasātasmin kāle mahāmohe prāptasevā trayo mahānpūrvakalpasya brahmaṇā sutagorakṣanāmataḥnavapuṃsaṃsthitāṃ loke anyastrī gaṇasaṃkulātāgatya daṇḍavadbhūmau tuṣṇiṃ bhūtamivāsthitaḥtataḥ prasanno jananī viśvamātā viraṃhasābho bho yogeśa abhyāsa gaccha yathāsukhamtasya aṃśasya guromāvarṇya te kiṃtusaketeyudhīṣṭhiro mahāpātra vasudeva sureśvarīprathamaṃ saṃtati jñānaṃ yogābhyāsāt samāhitasthāvare jaṃgame yestī viśveṣā sthitiraṃhasāyogābhyāsaṃ iti varaṃ datvā ca bhuvaneśvarītapaṃ cakāra vidhivadyogābhyāsena saṃkulāasmākamapi yogeśi bhuvanāmbā purasthitāḥbho bho brahmā mahāviṣṇu lokeśvara maheśvaraiti gorakṣavākyāni śrutvāsmān strībhirgaṇaiḥśṛṇu lokeśvarī tena brahmāviṣṇu mayā kṛtaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00291 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhuvaneśvaryā mahāmātrā chatrahastau mahottamaupūrvakalpasya kāryādi viśrutānāṃvarānepūrvakalpe bhavānmūrtyā bhagavatyā prakāśitātvaṃ viṣṇu sṛṣṭi sarveṣāṃ kartu pālana karmakṛtgāyatrī caivasāvitrī sarasvatyādi nāmataḥsṛṣṭisthityaṃ haret kāryaṃ kṛtvā kālānta prāpnutātvaṃ ca īśa mahādeva kālasya vaśago bhavettatastu brahmacarmāstaṃ devitvaṃ paridhānataḥsvapāda caraṇau seṣāṃ gaṇaṃ kṛtyavabhūratāḥvetālarūpamāsthāya yatra dṛśya surādhipaḥbhuvaneśvaryā sadā pṛṣṭhe cakāra sevitaṃ sadāpunaḥ sṛṣṭimicchatā satlokeśvaryā nimeṣataḥrudraṃ tvaṃ brahmaṇastvaṃ ca viṣṇustvaṃ mihakalpayoḥyuṣmākaṃ tu trayodevā jaganmohena mohitāasminmaṇi dvipaśudhānāmā siṃdho sureśvaraḥstrī bhāvopi gatā tubhyaṃ punarlokaṃ prakāśakaḥiti gorakṣa vākyāni śrutvātaṃ śailanaṃdinīśṛṇutvaṃ ca visālākṣi brahmavākyaṃ varānanepūrvaṃ megha?kakalpasya putratvaṃ buddhimānnaraḥasmiṃkāleṣu bho putra kiṃ na jānāmi viśrutājaḍohaṃ strī svabhāvohaṃ kiṃ seve śrī prasīdatiśṛṇutvaṃ mṛgasāvākṣi yathā bhāṣitagorakṣaḥsaptatriṃśallakṣakoṭi gatavāntaṃ manogaṇāna saṃśaya mahābhāga jagaḥ śṛṇvaṃ tu bho vidhāsaṃbaṃdhā gurugorakṣamaṃtraṃ prāptā varānane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00291 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jānehaṃ jānitā gaurī brahmaṇāpi ca jānitāiti jñātvā punargaurī paścācchrīgorakṣā paṃcavistarācchṛṇu bho gorī gorakṣanāmasahasrakamakārādi akārāntaḥ paścānnāmāni pūritaḥkālokāla khaṇḍakalpāṇa kalpakeśvaraḥkriṃkāramaṃtrarūpaśca krīṁkāra maṃtrakārakaḥkaraparvata vāsī ca karaparvata rūpakaḥkulācārya kulaṃdhrakulaṃdharayathā bhavānkalānatha kālanātha kulanātha khaleśvaraḥkhiṁ khiṁ bīja svarūpā ca khriṁkāra bījavādinaḥkhekāra khenivāsaśca khenātha khalapātakaḥkhasakāra khasakeśa khasanetra khaso mukhaḥkhaṇḍanātha khūranātha khūreśvara khurādhipaḥgo netragaṇanātha dhagaṇeṃdra gaṇanāyakagnīṁ gnīṁ bījasvarūpaśca gnīṁkāra bījavādinaḥgayāpiṇḍa svarūpaśca gayāsuraprakāśakaḥgaṃdheśvara gaṃdhavāhā gaṃdhamādana go śiraḥgaṃgānātha gaṃgarāja gaṃgādha gaṇāntakaḥghaṃṭahasta ghaṃṭakarṇa ghaṃṭamūrti ghaṭeśvaraḥghanākṣara ghanācārya ghaṇeśvara ghaṇāṃtakaḥghaṭaparvata vāsī ca ghaṭoghni gāvarasakaḥghṛṇi vidyā ca ghoṁkāra ghṛṇi tejasamastathāṅe rāṅa poṭaṅākāra ṅa ṭa parvatakārakaḥṅa simākarṇakāraśca karṇaphāṭaka mūrtinācaṇḍikā caṇḍikā nātha caṇḍaścaṇḍa ghātakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00291 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caṃcalāṅga caṃdraśira candraśekharacāturacaṃpakeśvara śrīmaṃta caṃpanāthaṃ ca arvakaḥchinnamastāpati chaṇḍa chaṇḍeyachaṇḍanāyakaḥchalanātha chalaḥ keśa chaṇḍabheda chalonmanaḥchedakarṇa chedamūrti chaḍaiśvara charistathāchatranātha chatravāsa chatraparvatakārakaḥjayaṃtikajāmunikajalarūpa jaleśvaraḥjalaṃdhara japajāyā jāyāpati jayākaraḥjayamālādharajātā jātāṃdhājāti bhedakājapanāthaśca jīṁkāra japaparvatavāsakaḥjanasiddhaśca janakajānakīpati sevakaḥjhapamāna jhiṃkāraśca jhīṃkāra bījavādinaḥjhaṃpāsuranivahaśca jhamaśabda prakāśakaḥjhakkā jhaṃpārvatīnātha jhaṁvargabījakārakaḥjhalanaṃ jhālanākāra jhāpera jhāṭi rūpakaḥñameñcara ñamo ñaṃtatrakāra bījavādinaḥñaṃ vagarūpa ñaṃtrīkantatrīmālā ñasāsikaḥṭaṃkeśvaraścaṭiṁkāra ṭiṭṭiṁ bīja svarūpakaḥṭaṃkanātha ṭaṃkakeśaṭaṃkalocana paṭakaḥṭāmareśvara ṭopāla ṭāṃkāraṭaṃkanāmasāṭuṃḍileśaṭuṃdanātha daṃḍanetra ṭasādhipaḥṭakāraśabda ṭāṃkāra ṭakapālāśca tārakaḥṭaruṇaśvara ṭāruṇika ṭārakatripurāṃtakaḥṭhunākāraṭhuṇamukhaḥ ṭhumaleśvara ṭhākuraḥsthitimūrtisthiramukhasthalāvāsasthaleśvaraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00291 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ḍaṃḍimukha ḍamarukāṃ taḍamaruvallabhastathāḍapānātha ḍāmarikaḥ ḍalanāyaka ḍuṃḍubhaḍhrīṁ bīja ḍhuchakāraśca ḍhuṃ ḍhumāra ḍhaleśvaraḥḍhimeśa ḍhamakāraśca ḍhuṃ ḍhuṃ śabda svarūpakaḥḍhārāḍhīreśvaraśceti ḍhatulānāḍhalaneśvaraḥṇalinaṇālinaṃ ṇādi ṇādaṇādeśvarastathātejakāṃtastejanātha taruṇeśvara tāṇḍavaḥtālavṛkṣasvarūpaśca tālaśabda prakāśakaḥtrīṁkāra bījarūpaśca trīṁkāra svaranālikaḥtārakarma svarūpaśca tripureśvara tāṃtrikaḥtripuraparvatādhīśa tripuraparvateśvaraḥtripurāsura aṃtaśca taṃtrika tāṃtrikī yathātaṃtreśvara taṃtramaya taṃtrītrāṇeśvarastathāthalavāsa thalakarṇa thālī thālādi rūḍhakaḥdāmarī damarodāma dīmodara dayākaraḥdāntikautuhalaṃ kuṇḍa damanāsuramardanaḥdāruṇa dāruṇādhīśa dāneśadānarūpakaḥdhārārūpa dharākāṃta dhāraṇaśca dhuraṃdharaḥdhanvantarī dhyānanātha dhyāneśvara dhalāṃtakaḥdharaṇīnātha dhanyātmā dhārmika dhamaleśvaraḥnārāmaṇanareśaśca nararūpa nṛpadhvajaḥnararakṣākaranīla nīlanātha narāntakaḥpūrṇacaṃdra pūrṇakāṃta pūrṇeśa pūrṇimāpatiḥpākhaṇḍapāpi nāśaśca parvata pārvatipatipātrapriyo pātradharapātre pātrasvarūpaka
source_edition: Muktabodha M00291 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pītāmbara dharapītapitātvaṃ putrarūpakaḥpātakī khaṇḍarūpaṃ ca pāṇḍavāvaradāyakāphatkireśvaraḥ phikhaṇḍaḥ phālāsana phaṇḍatathābalākara balānātha baleśvara vināyakaḥvidyādhara virūpākṣa viṣṇu tvaṃ vimalastathābileśvara bilvapriya bilāsa varuṇeśvaraḥbālasapabālanātha balāntakaḥbāṇahastapāṇarūpa vāṇanātha vasīkaraḥvāyunāthavāyurūpa vāyunāśakarastathābheṣīdharaḥ bheṣinātha bheṣīrakṣakabhillatāmahākālamahārudra mahādeva manurmaṇiḥmāhānātha māhānetra mahāvedamāhāsuraḥpalāpalāṃdhipayajanātha yameśvaraḥrathavāhāraladharā ralakārakaralakaḥrajaparvatavāsī ca rajaparvatakarakaḥlalanālākinī nātha laṃkeśodarpanāśakaḥlapamūrti laṃbanātha lājāpriya laṭhāḥkaraḥvananāvanimāmāravajanāvātivātulaḥśaktisiddhi siddhinātha śileśvara simākaraḥṣaganātha ṣaṃgamuṣaṣasī mukha ṣaleśvaraḥśaśinetra śaśimukha śāmbaśāmbheśvarastathāśaraṇāgata rūpaṃ ca śaraṇāgatarakṣakaḥhayanātha hayajñāna hayārī nāśahāṭakaḥhetopadeśa hetuṃśca hetukāraka hiṁkaraḥhanumatsakhahomasahā homasvarūpakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00291 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: harāṃśahararūpaṃ ca hareśvara hayaṃkaraḥhālānātha hālahatāṃtaka haṭeśvaraḥhananaṃ hāni rūpaṃ ca haṭamūrti halāyudhaḥkṣārarūpa kṣatradharakṣatranāyachādanaḥkṣapānātha kṣamānātha kṣetreśvara chalīmukhaḥkṣaurakarmeśvarakṣaura kṣauragaṃdharva kṣemajakṣatrīmardanarūpaṃ ca kṣatrokrodha svarūpakaḥkṣatrīmaṃtra vipākaṃ ca kṣāmikā kṣiṁkṣapākaraḥkṣāravārī svarūpaśca kṣātrāvīryasvarūpakaḥkṣapākareśvara kṣudrakṣaura dharmakṣamānidhikṣarajakṣīrarūpaṃ ca kṣīṇamūrtidharastathāarivargaprakāśaśca ariṇī aruṇeśvaraḥabjanaṃdana asthi ca asthika svara atrijaḥagniśca agnajanmā ca arkamaṇḍala arkajaḥarkanātha arka aṃśa āditya ādirūpakaḥādideva ādiyogī ādeśa ārtakāntakaḥādilokeśvara ālī āsīviṣa svarūpakaḥāsītanādhipaṃ āsa āśārūpeśvarastathāityācārya duṣṭarūpa duṣṭāgraha haleśvaraḥilāmārgaprakāśaśca iṣṭeśvara imānidhīiti gaṃdhasvarūpaśca iti sthāna nivāsakaḥindrarūpa indranātha indreśvara umāpatiugranāthaśca ugreśa ugrācārya umāsajaḥutrīrūpa utpattika utpatteśvara ugrajaḥugrasena sutāhaṃtī ugracaṃdra ṛtustathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00291 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṛtujñānavibhāgaśca ṛtu maṃtreśvarastathāraṃtideva ṛtu priyo ṛtuvīrya svarūpakaḥḷvarṇabījarūpā ca ḷvarga varṇarūpakaḥaiṁkāra aiṁ namovāṇī aiṁndraparvata vāsakaḥodraparvatavāsī ca odravidyā svarūpakaḥoturnātha otukara odrukāṃta ogaṃdhalaḥauṃtigaṃdhāvatī autya aucaparvata vāsakaḥaurvatejavata aulī aulīṃdhara dharastathāasura aṇḍajānātha aṇḍeśvarasubhaṃkaraḥaṃtakartika aṃkāra aṁbīja antarūpakaḥaṃkārabījavāsaśca aṇḍa atryaṃtaresthitaḥatalokarūpaśca ataleśvara arvagaḥagnikāntisvarūpaśca agnistaṃbhanarūpakaḥaduputra adupati aśleṣāpati adbidhaḥyakṣayakṣapati artha ajñānatītha rūpakaḥgorakṣanātha aṃtyeṣu iti nāmnādaśaṃ śatamsahasranāma paramaṃ yogīnāṃ caiva durlabhamnityaṃ paṭhati yo dhīmān prasanno bhava gorakṣasahasrajñānasaṃyuktaṃ sahasrasiddhisaṃyutamciṃtāmaṇi bhavedbhakta janā ānandakāritānityaṃ trikāle paṭhati trirāvṛtta maheśvarigatasaṃkhyā kṛtāvipraṃ bhojanaṃ sādhakairdadeśrīgorakṣaprasannostu asmākaṃ dṛśyata tribhiḥśrīgorakṣanāthasahasranāmastotraṃ nāmanavamastaraṅgaḥ
